description.value: A prospective longitudinal structural MRI study comparing cortical and subcortical patterns of neurodegeneration over time in Alzheimer's disease and behavioural-variant frontotemporal dementia.

value: we hypothesised that AD and bvFTD would show different patterns of cortical changes, predicated upon the location of initial brain atrophy observed in these dementia syndromes.
we predicted that cortical atrophy in AD would spread from posterior parietal to anterior regions, whereas in bvFTD, atrophy would spread posteriorly from the prefrontal cortex to the temporal lobes.
we hypothesised that direct comparisons between AD and bvFTD would reveal divergent patterns of cortical and subcortical degeneration over time.

spans.text: Specifically we predicted that cortical atrophy in AD would spread from posterior parietal to anterior regions, whereas in bvFTD, atrophy would spread posteriorly from the prefrontal cortex to the temporal lobes.
